edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the privileged owner state variable during construction.
The assignment sets the owner state variable.
Constructor owned() executes the owner assignment.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier performs the msg.sender == owner check.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the access control check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
balanceOf parameter who is used in the interface query.
transfer parameter to is used by the token transfer interface.
transfer parameter value is used by the token transfer interface.
set_amount is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
set_address is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
set_cooldown is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
new_amount is multiplied by 10**18 without overflow checks.
set_amount executes the multiplication that can overflow.
The multiplication result is stored into the amount state variable.
new_address parameter flows into set_address.
set_address overwrites the tokenAddress state variable.
new_cooldown parameter flows into set_cooldown.
set_cooldown overwrites the cooldown state variable.
_amount is scaled and passed to the external token transfer call.
withdraw performs the external token transfer.
tokenAddress is cast and called externally, enabling interaction with attacker-controlled code.
The external ERC20 transfer call dispatches into the token contract implementation.
play_paper delegates to play_game with value 0.
play_scissors delegates to play_game with value 1.
play_stone delegates to play_game with value 2.
The fallback function delegates to play_game with value 0.
play parameter flows into play_game.
msg.sender is used as the key into the readyTime mapping.
readyTime[msg.sender] is read in the cooldown requirement of play_game.
play_game derives the computer move from miner-influenceable block values.
The modulo of the block-derived hash is assigned to comp.
The player move influences the computed result.
play_game assigns the comparison result.
The computer move influences the computed result.
comp is packed into the record mapping entry.
play is packed into the record mapping entry.
result is packed into the record mapping entry.
play_game performs an external token transfer when the player wins.
tokenAddress determines which external contract is called during payout.
msg.sender is the recipient of the payout transfer, enabling reentrancy from the caller.
The amount state variable defines the payout value.
The payout external call dispatches into the ERC20 transfer implementation.
msg.sender is keyed into readyTime using the current block.timestamp.
cooldown is added to block.timestamp when updating readyTime.
The timestamp arithmetic result is stored into the readyTime mapping.
play is passed to compare as the player move.
comp is passed to compare as the computer move.
compare returns the outcome stored in result.
player parameter is used inside compare.
computer parameter is used inside compare.
compare assigns the local result variable.
orig parameter flows into judge.
judge decodes the result component.
judge decodes the play component.
judge decodes the computer component.
orig parameter flows into resolve.
resolve calls judge to decode the packed record.
resolve calls win to render the result string.
resolve calls mora to render the move strings.
orig parameter flows into mora.
_result parameter flows into win.
resolve assembles the returned string tuple.
The queried address is used as a key into the record mapping.
_address parameter flows into view_last_result.
view_last_result calls resolve to decode the record.
self_last_result uses msg.sender as the queried address.
self_last_result delegates to view_last_result.
_address parameter flows into view_readyTime.
readyTime[_address] is read for the subtraction.
view_readyTime executes the subtraction that may underflow.
The queried address selects the readyTime entry used in the subtraction.
self_readyTime uses msg.sender as the queried address.
self_readyTime delegates to view_readyTime.
play_game reads msg.sender for cooldown, record and payout logic.
view_last_result is queried with the caller-derived address in self_last_result path.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter only consumed by transferOwnership and should fold into that function node.
who parameter belongs solely to the balanceOf interface declaration.
to parameter belongs solely to the transfer interface declaration.
value parameter belongs solely to the transfer interface declaration.
new_amount feeds directly into the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
new_address is only used by set_address to update tokenAddress.
new_cooldown is only used by set_cooldown to update cooldown.
_amount is scaled and forwarded into the external transfer unsafe operation.
play is only consumed inside play_game game logic.
comp is produced by the weak randomness unsafe operation.
result is a transient game outcome local inside play_game.
player parameter is only used by compare.
computer parameter is only used by compare.
_result local holds the compare return value.
orig parameter is only used by judge.
_result is a decoded local inside judge.
_play is a decoded local inside judge.
_comp is a decoded local inside judge.
orig parameter is only used by mora.
_result parameter is only used by win.
orig parameter is only used by resolve.
The returned string tuple is a transient local of resolve.
_address parameter is only used by view_last_result.
_address parameter is only used by view_readyTime.
